title: Baga Beach, Goa
text: Baga Beach is a popular beach in North Goa with water sports, dolphin tours, and lively markets. Best visited Nov-Feb. Nearby: Calangute, Anjuna. Travel tips: avoid monsoon months, expect heavy crowds in December.

title: Lake Pichola, Udaipur
text: Lake Pichola is a scenic lake with boat rides to Jagmandir. Best at sunrise/sunset. Good heritage hotels nearby. Practical: book boat in advance during peak season.

title: Amber Fort, Jaipur
text: Amber Fort is a magnificent hilltop fort with stunning architecture and elephant rides. Visit early morning to avoid crowds. Sound and light show in evening. Budget: Entry ₹500, elephant ride ₹1000.

title: Kerala Backwaters
text: Kerala backwaters offer serene houseboat experiences through palm-fringed canals. Alleppey is the main hub. 1-night houseboat cruise costs ₹8000-15000. Best time: Sep-Mar. Includes meals and AC.

title: Pangong Lake, Ladakh
text: Pangong Lake is a stunning high-altitude lake with changing colors. Requires permits. Stay overnight at camps. Road journey from Leh takes 5-6 hours. Best visited Jun-Sep when roads are open.
